Possible Libraries & Tools: Optuna TPOT Auto-sklearn H2O.ai PyCaret AutoGluon FLAML scikit-learn GridSearchCV RandomizedSearchCV Hyperopt
Libraries & Methods Used in Current Code: The project uses a "model garden" approach with Optuna for extensive Hyperparameter Optimization (HPO). For each model in a given task type, Optuna runs a study to find the best hyperparameter combination based on a primary evaluation metric.
Key Performance Metrics (Train/Val/Test): Optuna's best_value reflects performance on internal validation splits. The metric optimized depends on the task type (e.g., F1 for classification, negative RMSE for regression, Silhouette Score for clustering).

Libraries & Methods Used in Current Code: sklearn.metrics is used to calculate performance scores. MLflow logs all parameters, metrics, and artifacts. matplotlib and seaborn (via plotting_utils.py) are used to generate diagnostic plots (e.g., confusion matrix, feature importance, actual vs. predicted, cluster PCA plots) which are logged as artifacts to MLflow. Optuna's plotting functions are used to create HPO diagnostic HTML files.
Key Performance Metrics (Train/Val/Test): Classification: F1-score (weighted), Precision (weighted), Recall (weighted), Accuracy, ROC AUC.<br>Regression: RMSE (Root Mean Squared Error), MAE (Mean Absolute Error), R² (R-squared).<br>Clustering: Silhouette Score, Davies-Bouldin Index, Calinski-Harabasz Index.
